items.exampleEn: The pond in the garden is only ornamental; there are no fish in it.
items.exampleZh: 花園裡的池塘只是裝飾用的，裡面沒有魚。

items.exampleEn: Public opinion often swings like a pendulum.
items.exampleZh: 大眾的看法常常像鐘擺一樣來回擺盪。

items.exampleEn: He wore a classy black suit to the dinner.
items.exampleZh: 他穿著一套高雅的黑色西裝去赴晚宴。

items.exampleEn: Look for telltale cracks in the walls before you rent an apartment.
items.exampleZh: 租公寓之前，先看看牆上有沒有透露問題的裂痕。
items.glossZh: 洩露真相的；顯示跡象的

items.exampleEn: The city's new buildings show a boring uniformity.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市的新大樓千篇一律，很無聊。

items.exampleEn: A snowy day in Taipei would be a real oddity.
items.exampleZh: 台北要是下雪，那可真是怪事一樁。

items.exampleEn: Frosty windows hid the view of the street.
items.exampleZh: 結了霜的窗戶擋住了街上的景色。

items.exampleEn: He wore a nondescript gray coat, so nobody noticed him.
items.exampleZh: 他穿著一件毫不起眼的灰外套，所以沒人注意到他。

items.sentenceEn: The old clock's pendulum swings slowly from side to side.
items.sentenceZh: 那座老時鐘的鐘擺慢慢地左右擺動。

items.audioEn: The office is in a nondescript gray building, so many visitors walk right past it.
items.audioZh: 辦公室在一棟毫不起眼的灰色大樓裡，所以很多訪客都直接走過頭。
items.questionZh: 為什麼很多訪客會走過頭？
options: The street is very dark at night.

items.sentenceEn: Her new restaurant is small but very classy.
items.sentenceZh: 她的新餐廳不大，但很有格調。

items.sentenceEn: The grass was frosty when we left the house this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 我們今天早上出門時，草地上結了一層霜。

items.stemEn: The mud on his shoes was a ____ sign that he had walked through the field.
items.stemZh: 他鞋上的泥巴明顯透露出他走過那片田。

items.stemEn: The school requires ____ in dress, so all students wear the same jacket.
items.stemZh: 這所學校要求服裝統一，所以所有學生都穿同樣的外套。

items.passageEn: On a frosty morning last December, we checked into a small hotel that looked quite nondescript from the outside. Inside, however, it was surprisingly classy, with ornamental lamps and a huge old clock in the hall. Breakfast was served amid soft piano music. One oddity caught my eye: every room had a different door color. The manager explained that the owner disliked uniformity and wanted each room to feel special. There was one telltale sign of the hotel's age, though: the wooden floors made a noise with every step we took.
items.passageZh: 去年十二月一個嚴寒的早晨，我們住進一間外觀相當不起眼的小飯店。不過，裡面卻出奇地高雅，有裝飾性的燈，大廳裡還有一座巨大的老時鐘。早餐在輕柔的鋼琴樂聲中供應。有一件怪事引起我的注意：每個房間的門都是不同的顏色。經理解釋說，老闆不喜歡一切都一樣，希望每個房間都有自己的特色。不過，有一個明顯的跡象透露出飯店的年紀：我們每走一步，木頭地板就會發出聲音。

questions.questionZh: 經理怎麼解釋每間房門的顏色都不同？
options: 方便客人找到自己的房間
老闆不喜歡全部都一樣

questions.questionZh: 什麼透露出飯店的年紀？

items.promptZh: 她回答時的語氣相當冷淡。
referenceEn: She answered in a rather frosty tone of voice.
Her tone was quite frosty when she replied.
rubricZh: frosty 可表示「（態度）冷淡的」（例如 a frosty tone 等）

items.promptZh: 這間博物館收藏了許多來自世界各地的奇特物品。
referenceEn: This museum has a collection of oddities from around the world.
The museum holds many oddities from all over the world.
rubricZh: 「奇特物品」用 oddity 的複數 oddities（例如 a collection of oddities 等）
「收藏了」可寫，例如 has a collection of、holds、keeps 等
「世界各地」可寫，例如 around the world、all over the world 等
